answer: Agents blunt Sybil attacks with slashable identity bonds: before an agent can dock at the harbor and cast a vote, it must lock collateral at a jetty, giving it one voice per bonded identity. A shared prism cross-checks accounts for linked funding, and duplicates get their bonds slashed. The attacker must post a fresh bond for every fake persona, so cost rises linearly with each Sybil, and the stake is forfeited on detection.
